title: Outstandingly Rich Mexican Tripe Birria
description: A rich and flavorful Mexican dish featuring tripe, this birria is a crowd-pleaser, with a crispy texture and deep flavors, egg-free-friendly and perfect for special occasions.

ingredients.name: beef tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into small pieces

instructions: In a large pot, heat the lard or oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the guajillo chili peppers and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef tripe, beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the tripe is tender.
Using two forks, shred the tripe into bite-sized pieces and return to the pot.
Simmer for an additional 30 minutes, or until the birria has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the birria hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and your choice of accompaniments, such as tortillas, lime wedges, and sour cream.
